snippet.title: Sovereign Tower - Out Now on Steam!
snippet.description:
Sovereign Tower is OUT NOW!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4113940/Sovereign_Tower/

Play as the Sovereign of a magical tower in this story-rich, Round Table management RPG. Recruit eccentric Knights, assign quests and balance egos whilst carving out your kingdom's destiny. If destiny doesn’t go your way, keep turning back time, uncover secrets and rewrite fate again and again.

Join the community:

Discord - https://discord.com/invite/w4XVQ69Vuc
Bluesky - https://bsky.app/profile/sovereigntower.bsky.social
X - https://x.com/SovereignTower
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/curvegames/?hl=en
